expectedText: I am comparing two apartments near my class. The first apartment has a larger bedroom, while the second has a more spacious kitchen. The monthly rent is lower at the first place, but I still need to ask about the electricity bill. I would also check whether the bathroom is private and whether the heating is included. Before I move, I want to read the lease and ask the landlord about any damage. I will take photographs of the wall and floor so I can discuss any marks clearly. The first place looks quiet enough for study, but I will compare the travel time and the full agreement before I decide.
